alert.rallyguard.scroll_of_rallying.stre: You started a Rally! Your guards within 100 blocks were teleported to you.
You ended the Rally! Your guards will wander around again.
gui.rallyguard.hire.title: Hire Guard
gui.rallyguard.hire.body:
Hire guards to join your army.
(cost: 3 emeralds).
gui.rallyguard.hire.already_owned: This guard is already part of your army.
item.rallyguard.commanders_ledger.toolti: Open the panel to command your guards.
gui.rallyguard.command.title: Command Panel
gui.rallyguard.command.empty: You haven't hired any guards yet.
gui.rallyguard.command.name: Guard
gui.rallyguard.command.not_owner: You are not this guard’s commander.
gui.rallyguard.command.squad_none_select: Select at least one guard first.
gui.rallyguard.command.attack_no_target: No valid target found for that order.
item.rallyguard.commanders_ledger.toolti: Sneak + right-click: mark a target or a formation point (air: clear marks).
gui.rallyguard.command.target_cleared: %s guard(s) no longer have a designated target.
gui.rallyguard.command.select_hint: Click guards (or a chip above) to select them
gui.rallyguard.command.kamikaze_issued: %s guard(s) charging %s. There is no way back.
gui.rallyguard.command.kamikaze_unarmed: No selected guard carries TNT in its off hand (give it one in its inventory).
gui.rallyguard.tip.summon: Teleport this guard next to you now.
gui.rallyguard.tip.post: Post this guard where YOU stand: it guards that spot and returns to it after every fight.
gui.rallyguard.tip.unpost: Release this guard from its post: it roams freely again.
gui.rallyguard.tip.select_all: Select every guard loaded around you (far-away villages are not included).
gui.rallyguard.tip.select_squad: Select every loaded guard of this squad.
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_name: Squad name to assign to the selected guards.
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_pick: Cycle through your existing squads (also selects that squad).
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_assign: Put the selected guards in the squad named on the left.
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_clear: Take the selected guards out of their squad.
gui.rallyguard.tip.stance_passive: Passive: never fights, not even when hit. Explicit orders still apply.
gui.rallyguard.tip.stance_defensive: Defensive (default): only fights back against whoever hits it.
gui.rallyguard.tip.stance_aggressive: Aggressive: attacks nearby monsters and enemy guards on its own.
gui.rallyguard.tip.stance_ruthless: Ruthless: attacks any nearby creature (never players, your guards or pets).
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_recall: To me: teleport beside you and follow you (leaves any post).
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_hold: Hold ground: stop and hold the spot where each guard stands now.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_reform: Back to the last formation they mustered in.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_break_ranks: Leave post/formation and act freely by stance (Reform brings them back).
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_kamikaze: Guards carrying TNT in the off hand run at the chosen target and blow up. They always die.
gui.rallyguard.tip.target_select: Who to fight: click to cycle. Sneak + right-click something with the Ledger to mark it.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_attack: Make the chosen target their target (and release their fire). Posted guards only fight it near their post.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_hold_fire: Weapons down: they won't fight at all, not even back, until released.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_release_fire: Weapons free: engage the designated target now if it's in reach.
gui.rallyguard.tip.muster: Form up in this shape on the marked formation point (or on you) and hold it.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_retreat: Break off the fight, forget the target, and re-form at the marked point (or on you).
